observations.description: Audit script is strictly read-only: Get-ScheduledTask + Get-ScheduledTaskInfo only. No Register/Unregister/Enable/Disable/Start/Stop-ScheduledTask or Start/Stop-Process. Validates single action+trigger, exact executable, arguments with -NoLogo/-NoProfile/-NonInteractive/-ExecutionPolicy/-File, working directory, owner (UserId), logon type (Interactive), run level (Limited), IgnoreNew, PT4M, PT5M, StartWhenAvailable, runner existence, Python existence.
Enablement requires audit to return state==Disabled and trading_authority==false before proceeding. Rejects anything except the exact audited disabled task.

Enablement requires: trading_authority==false, ready_for_unattended_operation==true, state==HEALTHY, observed_at >= startedAt (fresh), task State != Disabled, LastTaskResult == 0. All conditions must be met simultaneously.
Every failure path (catch block) disables the task with SilentlyContinue and rethrows. Timeout throw triggers catch → Disable-ScheduledTask.

Stale status (observed_at < startedAt), unhealthy state, authority escalation (trading_authority!=false), task failure (LastTaskResult!=0), missing status file, and malformed JSON all fail the if condition → loop → timeout → disable. Identity mismatch rejected by audit before enablement.

Removal requires action_verified==true and trading_authority==false from audit. Disable → Stop → Unregister (safe order). SilentlyContinue on Disable/Stop. No Remove-Item, no recursive delete. Evidence preserved (EVIDENCE_PRESERVED message).
No script references either recorder by name. No Register in audit/remove, no Unregister in enable/audit. Trading authority always false.

Documentation disclaims off-host notification, institutional readiness, and 24/7 operational-readiness. Describes deployment controls, rollback to disabled, evidence preservation, and gated enablement.
All scripts require PowerShell 5.1, use CmdletBinding, ErrorActionPreference=Stop. Audit uses ConvertTo-Json -Compress. Installer quotes -File path with backtick-escaped quotes.

Enable wraps Enable+Start+poll in try/catch with Disable in catch. Poll loop checks Get-ScheduledTask State, Get-ScheduledTaskInfo LastTaskResult, and status JSON every 3 seconds. Removal ordering: Disable → Stop → Unregister with SilentlyContinue. No race condition or rollback gap.

redundant: Some adversarial source-text assertions overlap with existing task tests on audit/enablement/removal source checks
